title: Page 7
content_zh:
她看着门窗外透出的人影，眼眶还是不争气地浮起泪波，好想……好想再见他一面。
「王……请回去吧。」她狠下心肠说道。「既然你无法信任我，我也无法再待在你身边了，咱们俩……还是别见面吧……」
伸出手，摸着映在门窗上的暗影，幻想自己其实正摸着他温热的脸庞，她只能以此慰藉自己的相思之苦，不敢再有进一步的举动，就怕自己会心生动摇，何况她觉得自己的时日已经不多了，恐怕真的熬不到春天来临的时候，多见上一面也只是徒增彼此的遗憾。
娘说她和他有缘分，大概他们俩的缘分还不够深，所以她无法长伴他左右，仅仅十年，缘分就尽了……
「本王不懂，为什么你会以为本王不信任你？」
「你命人将我抓住的那一刻，我的心有多寒，你或许永远都无法明了……」
兰霆万分惊诧，这才明白当时他顾全大局的举动，却在无意之间伤害了她，让她误会他对她不信任。
「雪莹，当时我并不是不信任你，那只是暂时的权宜之计，我一直深信你不可能会下毒害人。」他急切地解释。
但宗雪莹心中的结已打得深，不是简单几句解释就有办法解开的。「我又怎么知道，你是不是在明白误会了我之后，才用这种话来安慰我？」
现在再说什么，都已经迟了，误解一旦在心中种下，萌生的根便盘根错节的占据整颗心，紧紧地缠着，很难连根拔起。
「那到底要我怎么做，你才肯相信我？」既然误解已生，他只好想尽办法补救，希望能重新得到她的信任。「只要你说，我绝对为你办到！」
「王，我累了，恕我无法再和王多谈下去……咳咳咳……」
「小姐！」朵儿赶紧将虚弱的宗雪莹扶回床上，帮宗雪莹说话。「王，小姐真的累了，请王见谅。」
「雪莹！」兰霆心惊地听着宗雪莹咳声不断，像是非常痛苦，他的心也跟着紧紧揪痛，同样备受折磨。
他到底要怎么做，才能让她相信，他对她的心始终没有动摇过？难道要将他的心给挖出来，才能证明这一件事？
他一定要想办法，绝不轻言放弃，绝不！
兰霆没有勉强宗雪莹和他见面，却也没有离开云渺山，他决定住下，希望能软化她的心，解开两人之间的误会。
但在这之前，还有一件更重要的事，就是她的身子状况，真的撑不下去了？
「难道你们已经没有其他办法可以想了吗？」
前厅里，兰霆和宗薰、两名暂留在这的御医讨论着，他无法眼睁睁的看着宗雪莹在他眼前死去，他不可能放弃的。

「用药材延缓毒性蔓延的速度，本就有个限度，宗姑娘的身子可以撑到现在，已是非常不容易，微臣们真的已经尽力了。」御医无奈地回答。
兰霆派出去的人也没有寻找到可以解断魂草毒的办法，而现在唯一有希望的百灵昙又尚未开花，他们能想的办法、能做的事情都做了，却还是敌不过宗雪莹已不堪负荷的身子。
兰霆转而问向宗薰。「难道隐族没有其他的术数可以用在雪莹身上，再帮她拖延一些时间？」
只要再一点时间，只要能让她撑到春天百灵昙开花，她的命就有救了，难道上天连这最后一点时间也不愿给她，竟要他们眼睁睁看着她死？
宗薰表情凝重，犹豫了好久，才答道：「其实还有一个术数可用，那叫『同命咒』，也叫做『情咒』，是施在互相有情的一对男女身上，如果能在莹儿身上施同命咒，就能再替她拖延时间，直到百灵昙开花。」
「既然如此，你为何不早说？」兰霆双眼一亮，忍不住振奋。「这咒术到底要怎么用，你快说清楚！」
「转厄咒是找个替身承担自己所有的厄运，以此达到趋吉避凶的目的，但同命咒相反，它是让施咒的两人共同分担彼此的灾厄、福泽，等于两人从此之后祸福与共，承受着同样的命运。」
莹儿现在正承担着兰霆和她自己益加沉重的病厄，所以身子已经负荷不了，如果转而在她和兰霆身上施同命咒，莹儿身上原本承担的所有病厄会转移一半到兰霆身上，她身子的病厄负担减弱一半，也就能够帮她求得更多的时间，撑到百灵昙开花的日子。
而兰霆虽然同样承受一半的病厄，他现在身强体壮，承受得住病厄侵蚀，短时间内不至于有性命危险，只要一得到百灵昙，让莹儿服下，她身上的毒一解，他也就能跟着平安无事。
「那你就赶紧帮本王和雪莹施同命咒。」兰霆毫不犹豫地说道。「趁一切还能挽救前，快让本王分担她的病厄，如果真如你所说，同命咒可以共同分担彼此的祸福，那本王身上的福泽也能帮助她，让她更有机会度过这一次的危难。」
「但同命咒可能会带来无法预料的危险，甚至有人曾经因此而亡，所以我一直很犹豫，不知到底该不该冒这个险。」
「为什么？原因何在？」兰霆紧蹙起眉，既然有人安然无恙，就表示同命咒并不是不可行的。
「同命咒是因情而动，只要情一变，咒术便会起变化，轻则伤身，重则丧命，所以非到万不得已，还是别轻易……」
「族长，不好了！」朵儿一脸快哭出来的冲入厅里。「小姐她突然开始吐血，一直停不下来呀！」
「雪莹！」兰霆心急如焚地冲出去。
「莹儿！」宗薰也惊愕地跟着一起离开。
一行人赶紧来到宗雪莹的房里，此刻宗雪莹趴在床边，捂住嘴不停地呛咳，暗红色的血液不只染满她的手，还滴落在床沿，看起来触目惊心。
「雪莹！」兰霆冲到床边，将她紧紧抱在怀里，她早已吐得脸色惨白，气若游丝，像是随时都有可能晕过去。
「你……你来做什么……」她虚弱地说道。「我不想见你……请你让我一个人……好好静养……我……」
「雪莹，别再说话了。」他轻柔地为她拭净嘴角的血迹，深怕来不及救她，赶紧回头对宗薰道：「帮我和她施同命咒，快！」宗薰刚才的警告一点都影响不了他的决心，他愿意拿自己的命来分担雪莹的灾厄。

他这辈子只爱她一人，同命咒施在他们身上，绝对不会有危险！
宗薰见兰霆的态度坚定，而宗雪莹情况危急，已经不能再拖下去，不再迟疑，赶紧吩咐朵儿。「去我房里，把我施咒的银针拿过来。」
「是！」朵儿马上冲出房去。
「你们……想做什么……」宗雪莹已经无力推开兰霆，只能倒在他怀里，痛苦地喘气。「什么……同命咒……」
「雪莹，听我说。」他柔声说道。「从前只有你一人在承担病痛，所有的苦全都你独尝，但只要施了同命咒，咱们俩的命就会系在一起，我会陪着你，一同分担你的痛苦，从今往后，咱们俩祸福与共，同生共死，谁也别抛下谁。」
「你……别做傻事……」宗雪莹讶异地睁大眼，不敢相信他居然要用自己的命来救她。
「只要能挽回你的命，就不是傻事，我会用一辈子的时间，来让你明白，我不曾怀疑过你的清白，我甚至愿意用自己的命起誓，我的心如果有任何动摇，就让我天诛地灭，不得善终……」
「够了……别说了……」她痛心地落下泪来，她不要他陪着她痛苦，甚至是拿自己的命来涉险呀！
content_en:
She looked at the figure outside the door and window, tears still welling up in her eyes. She really wanted to... really wanted to see him again.
"King...please go back." She said with all her heart. "Since you can't trust me, and I can't stay by your side anymore, we two...it's better not to meet..."
She stretched out her hand and touched the shadow reflected on the door and window, imagining that she was actually touching his warm face. She could only use this to comfort herself from the pain of lovesickness. She did not dare to take any further actions for fear that she would be shaken. Moreover, she felt that her time was running out, and she was afraid that she would not be able to survive the coming of spring. Seeing each other more would only increase mutual regrets.
My mother said that she was destined to him. Maybe the fate between them was not deep enough, so she could not stay with him forever. After only ten years, the fate was over...
"I don't understand, why do you think I don't trust you?"
"You may never understand how cold my heart was the moment you ordered me to be captured..."
Lan Ting was extremely shocked, and then she realized that his actions that took the overall situation into consideration at that time had inadvertently hurt her and made her misunderstand that he did not trust her.
"Xueying, it's not that I didn't trust you at that time, it was just a temporary expedient. I have always believed that you would never poison anyone." He explained eagerly.
But the knot in Zong Xueying's heart was so deep that it couldn't be untied by just a few explanations. "How do I know that you only used these words to comfort me after you realized that you had misunderstood me?"
It's too late to say anything now. Once a misunderstanding is planted in the heart, the sprouting roots will become entangled and occupy the entire heart, entangled tightly and difficult to uproot.
"Then what do I have to do so that you will believe me?" Now that the misunderstanding had occurred, he had no choice but to find ways to remedy it, hoping to regain her trust. "As long as you say it, I will definitely do it for you!"
"King, I'm tired. Please forgive me for not being able to talk to the king any longer...ahem..."
"Miss!" Duo'er quickly helped the weak Zong Xueying back to the bed and helped Zong Xueying speak. "Wang, Miss is really tired, please forgive me."
"Xueying!" Lan Ting was horrified as he listened to Zong Xueying coughing continuously, as if she was in great pain. His heart also clenched tightly, and he was also tortured.
What on earth should he do to make her believe that his heart for her has never wavered? Do you have to dig out his heart to prove this?
He must find a way and never give up easily, never!
Lan Ting did not force Zong Xueying to meet him, but he did not leave Yunmiao Mountain. He decided to stay, hoping to soften her heart and resolve the misunderstanding between the two.
But before that, there is another more important thing: is her physical condition really unable to survive?
"Don't you have any other options?"
In the front hall, Lan Ting was discussing with Zong Xun and the two imperial doctors who were staying here temporarily. He could not watch Zong Xueying die in front of his eyes. He could not give up.
"There is a limit to using medicinal materials to slow down the spread of poison. It is very difficult for Miss Zong's body to be able to hold on until now. The ministers have really tried their best." The imperial doctor replied helplessly.
The people sent by Lan Ting have not found a way to cure the poison of the soul-breaking grass, and the only hope now is Bai Lingtan, which has not yet blossomed. They have done everything they can think of and can do, but they are still no match for Zong Xueying's already overwhelmed body.
Lan Ting turned to Xiang Zongxun. "Does the Yin clan have no other spells that they can use on Xueying to delay her for some time?"
As long as she has a little more time, as long as she can hold on until the larkspur blooms in the spring, her life will be saved. Could it be that God is not willing to give her even this last bit of time, and actually wants them to watch her die?
Zong Xun's expression was solemn, and he hesitated for a long time before replying: "Actually, there is another spell available., that is called the "Same Life Spell", also called the "Love Spell", it is cast on a man and woman who are in love with each other. If you can cast the Same Fate Spell on Yinger, you can delay her time until the Bai Lingtan blooms. "
"In that case, why didn't you tell me earlier?" Lan Ting's eyes lit up and he couldn't help but get excited. "How to use this spell, please tell me clearly!"
"The curse of reversal is to find a substitute to bear all one's misfortune, in order to achieve the purpose of seeking good luck and avoiding misfortune, but the opposite of the curse of fate is to let the two people who cast the spell share each other's misfortunes and blessings, which means that the two people share the same fate from now on."
Ying'er is now bearing the burden of Lan Ting's and her own increasingly heavy illnesses, so her body can no longer bear the load. If the same fate spell is cast on her and Lan Ting, half of all the illnesses that Ying'er originally bears will be transferred to Lan Ting. The burden of illness on her body will be reduced by half, which will help her buy more time until the day when Bai Ling Tan blooms.
Although Lan Ting also suffered half of the illness, he is now strong and can withstand the erosion of the illness, and his life will not be in danger in a short period of time. As long as he gets Bai Lingtan and lets Yinger take it, as soon as the poison in her body is removed, he will be safe and sound.
"Then you should quickly help me and Xueying cast the same fate spell." Lan Ting said without hesitation. "Before everything can be saved, let me share her illness. If it is true as you said, the same fate spell can share each other's misfortunes, then the blessings on me can also help her, giving her a better chance to survive this crisis."
"But the fate curse may bring unpredictable dangers, and some people have even died because of it, so I have been hesitant about whether I should take this risk."
"Why? What's the reason?" Lan Ting frowned. Since someone is safe, it means that the same fate curse is not impossible.
"The Spell of Same Fate is triggered by emotions. As long as the emotions change, the spell will change. It can harm the body at least, or kill you at worst, so don't do it unless it is absolutely necessary..."
"Clan leader, it's not good!" Duo'er rushed into the hall with a look on the verge of tears. "Miss, she suddenly started vomiting blood and couldn't stop!"
"Xueying!" Lan Ting rushed out anxiously.
"Ying'er!" Zong Xun also left in shock.
The group hurriedly came to Zong Xueying's room. At this moment, Zong Xueying was lying on the bedside, covering her mouth and kept choking. The dark red blood not only stained her hands, but also dripped on the edge of the bed, which looked shocking.
"Xueying!" Lan Ting rushed to the bedside and held her tightly in his arms. She had already vomited until her face turned pale and she was breathless, as if she might faint at any time.
"What...what are you doing here..." she said weakly. "I don't want to see you...please leave me alone...to rest well...I..."
"Xueying, stop talking." He gently wiped the blood from the corners of her mouth. Fearing that he would be too late to save her, he quickly turned back to Zongxun and said, "Help her and I cast the same fate spell, quickly!" Zongxun's warning just now did not affect his determination at all. He was willing to risk his own life to share Xueying's disaster.
He only loves her in this life, and if the same fate spell is cast on them, there will definitely be no danger!
Zong Xun saw that Lan Ting's attitude was firm and Zong Xueying's situation was critical and could no longer be delayed, so he stopped hesitating and quickly gave orders to Duo'er. "Go to my room and bring me the silver needle I used to cast the spell."
"Yes!" Duoer rushed out of the room immediately.
"What...what do you want to do..." Zong Xueying was unable to push Lan Ting away and could only fall into his arms, gasping for breath in pain. "What... the fate curse..."
"Xueying, listen to me." He said softly. "In the past, you were the only one bearing the pain, and you experienced all the suffering alone. But as long as we cast the same fate spell, our lives will be tied together. I will accompany you and share your pain together. From now on, we willWe both share weal and woe, we live and die together, no one should leave the other behind. "
"You...don't do anything stupid..." Zong Xueying opened her eyes wide in surprise, unable to believe that he actually wanted to use his own life to save her.
"As long as I can save your life, it's not a stupid thing. I will spend my whole life to make you understand that I have never doubted your innocence. I am even willing to swear on my own life. If my heart wavers in any way, I will be punished by heaven and earth without a good death..."
"That's enough... stop talking..." She shed tears sadly. She didn't want him to accompany her in pain, or even risk his own life!
